description: Interactions: the operations a Component offers, each over one Language it uses, and the Interactions Components import. Optional: a Component without Interactions is complete. Extends Kernel and Contexts.

axioms.about: An Interaction is over a Language its Component uses
axioms.formula: all i in Interaction. i.language in i.component.uses

axioms.about: Parameter types are in the vocabulary of the Interaction's Language
axioms.formula: all i in Interaction, p in i.parameters. p.type.language in i.language.*extends

axioms.about: The output is in the vocabulary of the Interaction's Language
axioms.formula: all i in Interaction. i.output.language in i.language.*extends

axioms.about: A Component imports an Interaction only from its siblings, or from what a Component it is nested in imports
axioms.formula: all c in Component, i in c.importedInteractions. i.component != c and (i.component in c.parent.components or i.component in c.system.components or i in c.^parent.importedInteractions or i.component in c.*parent.importedComponents)

axioms.about: An imported Interaction is over a Language the importer uses
axioms.formula: all c in Component, i in c.importedInteractions. some u in c.uses. i.language in u.*extends

axioms.about: Every Parameter of an Interaction is on its first/next chain
axioms.formula: all i in Interaction, p in i.parameters. p in i.first.*next

axioms.about: The first/next chain holds only the Interaction's Parameters
axioms.formula: all i in Interaction, p in i.first.*next. p in i.parameters
all p in Parameter. not p in p.^next
